“Space Rules?”

“He has mastered the Complete Space Rules?”

The Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank powerhouse stared at Lin Yuan, his eyes filled with astonishment.

Even the Six-Winged Elder, who ultimately managed to guess and perceive this fact, it was naturally clear to him too.

The moment the Galaxy Master instantly dispelled the silver-white cubic treasure containing the Complete Space Rules, the only possibility was his absolute control over space.

...

With just a thought, space is created.

And this, only those who had mastered the Complete Space Rules could achieve.

“Not even a hundred years old, and he has comprehended the Complete Space Rules?”

The Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank expert was somewhat stunned; the name of the Galaxy Master was also circulated among their Ninth Rank level, comprehending three kinds of high-level Cosmic Forces, almost inevitably becoming a Ninth Rank Evolver.

You should know, which of these Ninth Rank powerhouses didn’t go through countless hardships to enter this level?

Initially, this Tianyu Clan Ninth Rank thought that Lin Yuan’s current achievements had some luck, after all, comprehending Cosmic Force indeed involved randomness.

Cosmic Forces cannot be duplicated, cannot be simulated, there are no specific paths or directions.

Some brilliantly talented powerhouses might not comprehend a Cosmic Force in their entire life at the Eighth Layer, while some comparatively mediocre Eighth Layers might casually pick a direction and it might be a sort of Cosmic Force.

But now, since the Galaxy Master had comprehended the Complete Space Rules, it was different.

Comprehending Cosmic Force might involve randomness and luck, but fully understanding the Complete Space Rules could only rely on oneself.

And amongst the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, those who could comprehend the Complete Space Rules at the Eighth Layer were too few, far less common than Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses.

“This is going to be troublesome,” the Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank powerhouse furrowed his brows; an existence that had comprehended the Complete Space Rules was far more troublesome than an invincible Eighth Layer.

With a higher level of understanding of space, those who had comprehended the Complete Space Rules could completely make a mockery out of a group of invincible Eighth Layers by using layers upon layers of spatial layers to exile each invincible Eighth Layer into the depths of the void.

What’s more, the Galaxy Master was not just someone who had comprehended the Complete Space Rules.

“In this war, our clan must win,” the Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank expert immediately started contacting the clan’s powerhouses.

“Solante, you’re holding a Ninth Rank Defensive Treasure, come over,” the Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank expert used his own location as the coordinate, summoning a Tianyu Clan powerhouse from the old nest Star Domain of the Tianyu Clan.

Solante, one of the top ten geniuses of the current era of the Tianyu Clan, had a fifty percent chance of stepping into the Ninth Rank.

In just ten thousand years, he had understood a high-level Cosmic Force, and also delved deeply into his own Bloodline Talent, mastering three kinds of Bloodline Talents.

The Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank didn’t hope for Solante to defeat the Galaxy Master; as long as he could hold him off, or entangle part of the Galaxy Master’s attention, that would suffice.

As long as the Galaxy Master couldn’t unscrupulously act against the Tianyu Clan’s invincible Eighth Layers, then the Tianyu Clan still had a chance to win this war.

…

On the side of Human Civilization.

Within the numerous Spatial Layers, a Ninth Rank Evolver was also incredibly surprised as he observed Lin Yuan.

His name was ‘Xilan’, a Ninth Rank Evolver stationed by Human Civilization at this battlefield.

“He actually comprehended the Complete Space Rules?”

Xilan blinked his eyes; it had taken him thousands of years to comprehend the Complete Space Rules.

These thousands of years were after stepping into the Ninth Rank.

Xilan, from his lofty position, found it much easier to comprehend Space Rules compared to an Eighth Rank Evolver.

“This little guy…”

Xilan was at a loss for words for a moment.

Anyone who could become a Ninth Rank was a proud figure of his generation, but now compared to the Galaxy Master, he felt he had lived these years in vain.

“The talent and aptitude of the Galaxy Master are even beyond what the rumors suggested; such a treasure must be well protected,” Xilan immediately spirited himself up, preventing the Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank powerhouses from making a desperate move.

Even if the present Galaxy Master was just an Avatar, weren’t there methods to affect the original body through the Avatar?

Xilan had already placed the importance of the Galaxy Master above the outcome of the war in his heart.

The war with the Tianyu Clan could be lost, but the Galaxy Master absolutely must not come to harm; if necessary, he would tear apart the unspoken rules just to ensure the Galaxy Master was safe.

…

In the middle of the battlefield.

Lin Yuan was checking the contents of the Six-Winged Elder’s Space Bracelet.

“Really poor.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; there was nothing of much value in the bracelet, all put together would probably amount to a few thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

This was quite normal, the invincible of the Eighth Layers who dared to come to the battlefield, were mostly prepared to die, naturally, they wouldn’t carry valuable treasures on them.

“But this space secret treasure should be quite valuable,” Lin Yuan glanced at the silver-white cubic object beside him.

This secret treasure was the Tianyu Clan’s trump card against the war to prevent Human Civilization from deploying a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure.

The result ended up in Lin Yuan’s hands.

Just then.

A Tianyu Clan powerhouse with eight pairs of wings on his back wearing a purple armor appeared on the battlefield following spatial fluctuations.

“My name is Solante, Galaxy Master, your opponent is me,” as soon as Solante appeared, the many invincible Eighth Layers of the Tianyu Clan, who had been in chaos, felt a bit more settled in their hearts.

Solante was one of the top ten geniuses below the Ninth Rank of the Tianyu Clan, much stronger than the previous Six-Winged Elder.

And the purple armor Solante was wearing emitted profound and distant fluctuations, obviously a Ninth Rank Defensive Treasure.

With Solante’s strength, plus a Ninth Rank Defensive Treasure, even if the Galaxy Master had comprehended the Complete Space Rules, dealing with him wouldn’t be easy.
